description: Allowlist for the dependency supply-chain audit gate (issue #178). Entries here are packages that do NOT yet publish provenance/attestation metadata. They are treated as an accepted, non-blocking gap: the CI gate reports them for visibility and tracks provenance coverage as a baseline to improve over time. Do NOT add entries to silence real signature verification failures.

provenanceGaps.reason: Publisher does not yet support npm provenance attestation; tracked as an accepted gap.

baseline.note: Baseline provenance-coverage percentage. Update this value as more dependencies publish attestations. The CI gate fails only on signature verification errors, not on missing provenance.
